facts.fact: IFAD and China launched the $2.268 million SAT-CARE project in May 2025 to support the Ministry of Agriculture in developing a satellite-based agricultural information system with a digital agriculture platform and mobile advisory services.
The article says the country's National Food Security Bulletin is already using satellite-derived vegetation data.

systems.platform: satellite-based agricultural information system, digital agriculture platform and mobile advisory
systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture, with IFAD and China
